observations.text: This is exactly the kind of thing I want. Control+Option+V over whatever app I'm in, type an address or card number with Return — that's the whole point for me, filling forms without retyping. Two things I'd worry about: I basically never open settings or read the setup screens, so I'd just assume it's ready because it opens at launch. And if ordinary details like my address start asking for Touch ID, I'll get annoyed and stop using it. Keep the fingerprint only for the genuinely sensitive stuff and I'm in.
